reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per MRR change of a subscription of a German account
  SELECT e.subscription_id, e.event_type, e.mrr_delta_local, e.recorded_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.subscription_id ORDER BY e.recorded_at DESC, e.event_id) AS rn
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  WHERE a.country_code = 'DE'
)
SELECT subscription_id, event_type, mrr_delta_local, recorded_at
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
SELECT e.subscription_id, e.event_type, e.mrr_delta_local, e.recorded_at
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
WHERE a.country_code = 'DE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e2
                  WHERE e2.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
                    AND (e2.recorded_at > e.recorded_at OR (e2.recorded_at = e.recorded_at AND e2.event_id < e.event_id)))

SELECT t.subscription_id, t.event_type, t.mrr_delta_local, t.recorded_at
FROM (
  -- one row per MRR change of a subscription of a German account
  SELECT e.subscription_id, e.event_type, e.mrr_delta_local, e.recorded_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.subscription_id ORDER BY e.recorded_at DESC, e.event_id) AS rn
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  WHERE a.country_code = 'DE'
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1

solver.query:
SELECT subscription_id, event_type, mrr_delta_local, recorded_at
FROM (
  SELECT e.subscription_id, e.event_type, e.mrr_delta_local, e.recorded_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.subscription_id ORDER BY e.recorded_at DESC, e.event_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  WHERE a.country_code = 'DE'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
